observation.convergence_note: Independent truth archaeology says project-facultad remains REGISTERED_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED with no promoted served Facultad route. This UX audit preserves that authority result while adding product-level evidence discovered from recent Study Library commits and exact branch bytes.

identity_scope.identity_rule: Do not collapse project-facultad authority, pages/study-library recent product lineage, and older catalogued shared/study family into one owner until registry/current authority explicitly resolves them.

current_authority: project-facultad is registered but discovery-required and unbound.
No promoted Served Facultad Digital route is established by the independent truth return.
current_branch_evidence: pages/study-library/index.html has identical main and gh-pages blobs and is the newest Study Library implementation lineage found by commit archaeology.
CURRENT_GRAPH and CATALOG_MANIFEST do not contain a study-library entry, so branch publication is not equivalent to canonical Current/Served authority.
candidate: All UX changes and flow proposals in this artifact are candidates only.
A future surface registry/local integration may bind the recent Study Library artifact to Facultad only through its own authority contract.
historical_related: shared/study/* remains registered RECOVERED Study-family evidence and reusable design lineage.
V4-V15 runtime assets still load beneath V18 and must be treated as legacy/runtime dependencies, not evidence that their old UI is the current design.

recent_behavior_to_protect.behavior: Four academic-year selector with semester shelves and V18.6 fixed year-number/suffix axis plus calmer semester labels.
Switching year preserves vertical viewport position.
Newly rendered semester shelves reset horizontally to their start.
Course cards support pointer and keyboard Enter/Space activation, horizontal drag suppresses accidental click, and course identity deep-links with ?course=<course_id> plus popstate.
Theme choice persists locally and legacy/version-anterior access remains available.

ux_friction.finding: Target identity is not deterministic for a one-message Facultad correction: project-facultad is unbound, the newest pages/study-library artifact is absent from CURRENT_GRAPH/CATALOG_MANIFEST, and older shared/study pages are the registered Study family.
ux_friction.failure_mode: A worker or human can route a Facultad correction to the wrong Study lineage or silently treat branch publication as authority.
ux_friction.preferred_fix_class: surface-registry/authority resolution, not local UI guessing

ux_friction.finding: The recent Study Library surface has no visible Page Change Thread/Capture correction affordance. Its options expose login (stub), theme, and previous version; the root Prometeo menu likewise does not expose Study Library/Facultad.
ux_friction.failure_mode: The human cannot naturally issue one correction from the page and get a durable result back to that same surface without leaving the flow or supplying routing context manually.
ux_friction.preferred_fix_class: reuse Page Change Thread bridge + owner shell context capsule

ux_friction.finding: The URL/history preserves course_id but not selected academic year, active course tab, semantic anchor, or viewport. activeTab resets to notes and openYear resets to 1; popstate restores only home/course.
ux_friction.failure_mode: A correction/preview/reload can return to the right course but the wrong tab/year/context, violating same-surface return semantics.
ux_friction.preferred_fix_class: capture and restore semantic page context; avoid raw scroll-only identity

ux_friction.finding: The modern V18 UI can fetch its local curriculum/enrichment and render independently, but the blocking startup overlay is owned by study-v10-loader.js, which first awaits remote Supabase config and then sequentially awaits 13 legacy/core scripts before hiding the overlay.
ux_friction.failure_mode: Modern time-to-visible and failure semantics remain coupled to the full legacy stack; slow or failed legacy/config work can hide an otherwise renderable V18 surface.
ux_friction.preferred_fix_class: decouple visible V18 readiness from lazy legacy/tool readiness

ux_friction.finding: Several modern course sections are presentation-complete but backing flows are partial: login says 'próximamente', Cronograma is an explicit stub, class-note rows use 'Fecha por definir', and multiple flows fall back to Versión anterior.
ux_friction.failure_mode: The interface can imply a more complete native V18 workflow than currently exists and send users back into legacy paths at task time.
ux_friction.preferred_fix_class: make capability state explicit and progressively replace stubs without removing legacy escape hatches

ux_friction.finding: The current entry stacks many CSS/runtime generations (V4 through V18.6) plus patch layers. Recent V18.5/V18.6 fixes are small but regression-sensitive.
ux_friction.failure_mode: Broad cleanup can unintentionally erase accepted/recent shelf-start, scroll-preservation, drag/click or year-label behavior.
ux_friction.preferred_fix_class: surgical dependency reduction with regression tests before deletion

ux_friction.finding: Boot failure semantics are split: the legacy loader can show 'No pude iniciar Study Library' while V18 has an independent render path underneath.
ux_friction.failure_mode: The visible error can overstate total surface failure when only the legacy/tool bootstrap failed.
ux_friction.preferred_fix_class: separate shell-ready, tool-ready and degraded-mode states

one_message_correction_target.goal: From the current Study surface, one human message should create a scoped change thread and return a verified visible result to the same semantic location without the human transporting routing/context.
flow: Capture surface_id + resolved authority status + canonical artifact/source blob.
Capture semantic context: course_id if present, selected year, active tab, semantic anchor and viewport fallback.
Send the correction through the shared Page Change Thread bridge; do not create a Facultad-only orchestration stack.
Local planner/worker changes isolated candidate scope; local steward verifies and reconciles dependencies.
Return a preview/candidate to the exact course/year/tab/anchor context.
Keep Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion as a separate authority action.

falsification_tests.test: Open a course on Cronograma, issue one correction, open the returned preview/candidate and verify the same course + Cronograma tab + semantic anchor are restored.

Select year 3 at a nonzero vertical viewport, execute a correction round trip, and verify year 3 plus the semantic viewport return; newly rendered shelves still begin at horizontal start unless an explicit shelf position is part of the context contract.
Throttle or fail the legacy config/core bootstrap while local V18 curriculum/enrichment remain available.
falsification_tests.pass: The V18 shell becomes usable without waiting for all 13 legacy scripts; legacy-dependent tools expose a scoped degraded/loading state instead of blocking the whole page.

falsification_tests.test: Send a fresh worker the target 'Facultad' without transcript context.
falsification_tests.pass: It resolves through explicit surface/project authority or stops as unresolved; it never guesses shared/study or pages/study-library solely from recency/name.

falsification_tests.test: Visual regression at desktop, <=620px and <=300px after any shell/context integration.
falsification_tests.pass: Year number/suffix axis, semester-label breathing room, horizontal shelf behavior and vertical year-switch position match the V18.6 baseline.

falsification_tests.test: Drag a semester shelf horizontally and release over a course card.
Focus a course card and activate with Enter and Space.
falsification_tests.pass: Both open the course and preserve history/deep-link behavior.
Version anterior and required legacy tools remain reachable when invoked.

falsification_tests.test: After registry integration, inspect authority surfaces.
falsification_tests.pass: Exactly one explicit modern Study Library surface identity is resolvable for its intended Facultad scope while older shared/study lineage remains historical/recovered rather than overwritten.

non_obvious_findings: The newest Study Library implementation is discoverable through recent commit lineage and is byte-identical on main/gh-pages, yet it is absent from CURRENT_GRAPH/CATALOG_MANIFEST and the independent truth worker correctly found no promoted Facultad served route. Recency/publication and authority are therefore materially divergent here.
V18's modern home is not the real startup critical path: a legacy V10 loader still owns the blocking overlay and serializes remote config plus 13 scripts before declaring the library visible.

Course deep-linking is only partially contextual: ?course= survives, but year/tab/anchor do not, which is enough to make a one-message correction return feel like a context reset even when the correct course is reopened.

dedup.need: Resolve canonical surface/project route and prevent old/new Study lineage guessing.
One-message correction plus context capsule and same-surface return.
Reuse shared PageKit/Prompt/Context/Capture owners rather than fork Faculty-specific substrate.
Protect stacked-runtime and V18.5/V18.6 regression-sensitive behavior while reducing boot coupling.
Backfill/stage native Cronograma/notes/login flows without removing legacy escape hatches prematurely.
